earlier_device_acceptance: Earlier native2 owner acceptance and separate local recovery.2 observations on one reviewed unit; neither validates this merged source.3 snapshot

differences_from_earlier_tv_build: Public baseline config replaces personal appearance; empty legacy redirect class retained.
Source.2 idempotent Start/delivery, pending ownership release, matching stale-failure barriers and runtime status are preserved.
Guarded START_STICKY process recreation consumes a committed private budget under the Stop session monitor; recovery cannot enable an Off choice.
At most two null-intent process-recreation admissions per anchored ten-minute window; boot starts are not charged and do not reset a same-window budget.
Only an admitted null-intent recovery normalizes this app's own foreground state before fresh calibration; firmware pins and Home policy timing stay unchanged.
Explicit Stop cancels service restart and attempts durable Off; failed persistence remains unverified.
Recovery/foreground and merge-interaction JVM regressions supplement source.2 coverage; see BUILD.md for host check results.
Source.3 version and unsigned release build; automatic install/debloat scripts excluded.
hardware_limits: This merged source.3 snapshot has no TV install or hardware acceptance; its JVM checks do not exercise actual Android service scheduling, firmware event publication, receiver delivery or remote hardware.

Separate local recovery.2 trial: one controlled app-process crash recovered in about seven seconds without a manual revival; this does not establish the original death cause or every OEM/low-memory kill path.

Separate local recovery.2 reboot observation followed owner Wi-Fi reconnection; the observer was ready before a maintenance Start. Screensaver acceptance used Start now, not an inactivity-timeout wait.
Physical PS5/audio/HDR, held volume, remote hardware and phone casting were not re-tested in that recovery trial.
An already-visible Google Home may lack fresh resume evidence; open the app named Home from Google's Apps tab as fallback.
Budget expiry schedules no retry, and force-stop is not the sticky-recreation path.
Immediate Stop/Start during observer teardown fails closed and requires retry after teardown.
A stale in-flight clock confirmation can conservatively invalidate its observer; session barriers reject stale Stop/error writes, not every transient availability loss.
Research source retains the original package identity; no independent installer or coexistence claim.
